app.title: ReForge AI
app.tagline: Fill your forms in your language
language.picker.title: Choose your language
language.picker.subtitle: Questions will appear in the language you choose.
language.picker.trySampleHint: Opens a made-up clinic registration form, so you can see how it works before you use your own.
upload.title: Upload your form
upload.privacyNotice: Your answers stay in your browser. The form field labels, tooltips, and nearby text from the PDF — and any description answer you choose to translate — are sent to the AI service for processing. Answers are not stored.
upload.error.tooLarge: This file is too large. Please use a PDF under 10 MB.
upload.error.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Please remove the password before uploading.
upload.error.xfa: This PDF uses an older format (XFA) that is not supported. Please use a standard AcroForm PDF.
upload.error.signed: This PDF has already been signed and cannot be edited.
upload.error.noFields: This PDF has no form fields to fill in.
upload.error.tooManyPages: This PDF has too many pages (maximum 20).
upload.error.tooManyFields: This PDF has too many fields (maximum 150).
upload.error.invalidPdf: This file does not appear to be a valid PDF.
mock.question: Please enter: {label}
analysis.demoMode: Demo mode — AI responses are simulated
confirm.title: Confirm form language
confirm.detected: We detected this form is in {language}.
confirm.cjkUnsupported: Chinese-language forms are not supported yet. Please use an English or Malay form.
wizard.lowConfidence: We are not sure about this field. Please confirm the question before answering.
wizard.fillYourself: Fill this field yourself after printing.
wizard.readOnly: This field is set by the form.
validation.required: This field is required. Please enter a value or skip.
validation.maxLength: This answer is too long (maximum {max} characters).
validation.ic.invalid: This is not a valid Malaysian IC number. Please check and try again.
validation.ic.invalidDate: The date in this IC number is not valid. Please check.
validation.ic.invalidBirthplace: This is not a recognised birthplace code. Please check the number.
validation.ic.wrongLength: An IC number must have 12 digits.
validation.phone.invalid: This does not look like a valid phone number. Please check.
validation.phone.needsCountry: Which country is this phone number from? Add the country code, for example +60.
validation.postcode.my.invalid: A Malaysian postcode must be exactly 5 digits.
validation.date.invalid: This is not a valid date. Please check.
validation.date.chooseFormat: Which date format does this form use? Choose one before you enter the date.
validation.date.wrongFormat: Write the date as {format}, for example {example}.
validation.date.confirmFormat: Please confirm the date format: is this {format}?
validation.email.invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.zip.invalid: Please enter a valid ZIP code (e.g. 12345 or 12345-6789).
validation.ssn.invalid: This Social Security number format is not valid. Please check.
validation.dropdown.invalid: Please select one of the available options.
validation.radio.invalid: Please select one of the available options.
validation.glyph.unsupported: Some characters in your answer cannot be written to this PDF. Please check.
review.title: Review your answers
review.privacyNotice: Your answers stay in your browser. The form field labels, tooltips, and nearby text from the PDF — and any description answer you choose to translate — are sent to the AI service for processing. Answers are not stored.
review.field.status.skippedRequired: Skipped. This field is required, so the office may ask you to fill it in.
review.required.warning: Required field not answered. Answer it, or skip it on purpose.
download.error.overflow: Some text is too long for its field. Please shorten your answer.
download.error.glyph: Some characters cannot be written to this PDF.
download.error.generic: Something went wrong preparing your PDF. Please try again.
error.aiUnavailable: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
error.aiQuota: The AI service has reached its daily limit. Please try again tomorrow.
error.timeout: This took too long. Please try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
analysis.slowNote: This can take up to a minute. Keep this page open.
analysis.cached: The AI service is busy, so you are seeing a saved analysis of this sample form.
confirm.languageLabel: Language for your answers on the form
confirm.countryHint: The country decides how phone numbers, postcodes and ID numbers are checked.
wizard.nearbyText: Text near this field on the form: {text}
wizard.translationLabel: Machine translation for the form. Read it, edit it if needed, then approve it.
wizard.translationApproved: You approved this translation. It will be written to the form.
hint.ic.MY: 12 digits, with or without dashes. For example 900101-14-5678
hint.phone.other: Include the country code, for example +60 12-345 6789
hint.postcode.US: 5 digits, or 5 + 4 digits, for example 02108 or 02108-1234
review.field.status.unanswered: Not answered. The field stays empty.
review.errorSummary: Answer or skip these required fields before you download:
download.checkNote: Open the PDF and check every answer before you hand it in. ReForge AI does not send the form anywhere.
accessforge.notice.title: What leaves your browser
accessforge.notice.pageText: Labels and nearby text from the old page go to the AI service.
accessforge.notice.answersStay: Your answers stay in this browser until you confirm.
accessforge.notice.legacyOnly: When you confirm, your answers go only to the demonstration portal's own form handler.
